declare @_1so_hd$ varchar(33), @_1da_tt numeric(28, 6), @nCount int select @_1so_hd$ = _1so_hd from dmhd where ma_hd = @ma_hd
select top 0 a.* into #d from @@table a right join (select null b) b on 1 = 0 insert into #d select * from @@table where @@whereClause select top 1 @nCount = line_nbr from #d order by line_nbr desc if @nCount is null set @nCount = 0
insert into #d(ma_hd, line_nbr, ma_dot, ngay_du_chi, tien_chi, dot_so) select @ma_hd, @nCount + row_number() over(order by ma_dot), ma_dot, null, 0, 0 from zhdtt00 a where ma_hd = @_1so_hd$ and not exists(select 1 from #d where ma_dot = a.ma_dot)
select @_1da_tt = sum(tong_da_tt) from zhopdongtt where ma_hd = @_1so_hd$ if @_1da_tt is null set @_1da_tt = 0
select row_number() over(order by line_nbr, ma_dot) as ln, ma_hd, line_nbr, ma_dot, tien_chi * 0 as tien_da_chi, cast(null as smalldatetime) ngay_da_chi, tien_chi * 0 as tien_con_lai into #b from #d update #b set tien_da_chi = b.tl_da_chi, ngay_da_chi = b.tl_ngay_da_chi from #b a join zhdtt00 b on b.ma_hd = @_1so_hd$ and a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot
update #b set tien_con_lai = @_1da_tt - tien_da_chi where ln = 1 declare @ln int = 2 while exists(select 1 from #b where ln = @ln) begin update #b set tien_con_lai = b.tien_con_lai - a.tien_da_chi from #b a, (select * from #b where ln = @ln - 1) b where a.ln = @ln
set @ln = @ln + 1 end
select @@fieldExternal from #d a left join #b b on a.line_nbr = b.line_nbr and a.ma_dot = b.ma_dot where a.ma_dot <> '' order by @@orderByClause
